plugins.name: off-grid-review
plugins.description: Your AI changes 50 files and you can't tell what broke. Every change gets a pass or fail against one clear bar, and every review comment gets answered and fixed before it merges.

plugins.name: off-grid-testing
plugins.description: You fix one bug and two old features break. Every change gets tested by tapping through your app like a real user, with no mocks hiding the breakage.

plugins.name: off-grid-codebase
plugins.description: You inherit a codebase nobody fully understands, and every change is a guess. Your AI maps it first, shows you what each change will break, and adds tests before it touches anything risky.
